A '''Brosso Mark II''' was the brand name of an older style of [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. After an aborted [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] run down the [[Rampa Rapids]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] ended up with a Brosso Mark II projector, which he later used as part of a makeshift [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheatre]] during his stay in the [[Kamar Badlands]].

Solo used the projector to show the only film he had access to: a [[holodocumentary]] called ''[[Varn, World of Water]].'' Though Han found it quite dull, it fascinated the local [[Kamarian]] [[Kamarian Badlander|Badlanders]]. Due to communication difficulties, he failed to realize that the desert folk revered water and had set up a [[Cult of Varn|religion]] around his depictions of a water planet. He discovered his error after the cult members rioted when he attempted to show another film, ''[[Love is Waiting]],'' forcing Solo and his companions to flee in the [[Millennium Falcon]].
